content: crossbeam-channel 0.5.17 (MSRV 1.60, MIT/Apache-2.0): designed to beat std bounded sync_channel, but modern benchmarks are mixed - std bounded channels improved (1.67+ unbounded mpsc rewritten crossbeam-style) and std can be faster at large capacities; std SyncSender is already clonable multi-producer single-consumer which matches the extractor-to-worker fan-in; select!/len not needed by the engine; adding crossbeam buys no capability the engine lacks.
